verdict.rationale: Canny ships 'Autopilot,' an automated AI feature that captures and categorizes feedback from support/sales/review sources without user intervention, and users can 'send new conversations to Autopilot' to have it process feedback — a limited form of task delegation to a built-in AI component. However, this is not a general-purpose conversational assistant embedded in the Canny UI; the richer AI interaction (asking questions, taking actions, drafting PRDs) is delivered via MCP connecting to *external* LLMs like ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor, not a native in-product assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive, conversational built-in assistant UI, an example of delegating arbitrary multi-step tasks to it, and independent/hands-on confirmation of Autopilot's task-delegation behavior beyond marketing copy.
